# @stackline/ndarray-ops@1.0.1 on Alexandro.Net

- Canonical documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/ndarray-ops/
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@stackline/ndarray-ops
- Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-ndarray-ops
- Upstream compatibility baseline: ndarray-ops@1.2.2
- Runtime: Node.js 18 or newer and modern browsers
- Module formats: CommonJS, ESM, AMD, and classic browser global
- Types: TypeScript 3.9-compatible CommonJS declarations and modern conditional ESM/CJS declarations
- Production closure: one root node and zero dependencies
- License: MIT

Identity-preserving npm alias:

ndarray-ops@npm:@stackline/ndarray-ops@1.0.1

The package exposes all 150 historical operations, preserves ndarray shape,
stride, offset, order, generic-storage, alias and block-traversal behavior for
valid views, and uses no runtime string compilation. Invalid, non-finite or
out-of-range view metadata is rejected synchronously.
